identity.artist_sensitivity: Separate descriptive sensitivity on explicitly selected leading results; no new primary tests or q values
identity.execution_order: ascending candidate hash, all approved candidates; no screening
identity.global_correction: BY across all 9,159 attempted candidates, unavailable/failed p=1
identity.inference: EXPLORATORY FULL PHASE 1; previously inspected population; no independent confirmation

configuration.inference: exploratory; block resampling assumes short-range dependence; no independent confirmation
configuration.inner_rule: two consecutive five-year validation blocks ending at each outer start; expanding history; whole chart windows purged
configuration.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Yekutieli across all attempted pilot primary hypotheses; invalid/unavailable p values contribute p=1; also report family BY
configuration.nominal: fixed genre labels/one-hot membership; never arbitrary numeric distances
configuration.ordinal: best_chart_rank: Spearman, dependence and temporal descriptions only; no cardinal-response regression
configuration.pairwise_primary_test: permute the response within debut year; pooled statistic; conditional year-exchangeability null
configuration.pilot_sampling: smallest seeded candidate hashes within predefined domain/type/category strata
configuration.population: songs.csv; observed history completed before 2026-01-01 for association/temporal analyses
configuration.preserve_categories: A retained in inventory; B retained and labelled; C strict; D/E are additional family tags, not replacements
configuration.revision_reason: Constant-subgroup guard and explicit predictor-complete counts; candidate universe and selection rules unchanged from v1
configuration.status: PILOT ONLY; no full campaign command

identity.precision: Frozen pilot resampling; no selective p-value refinement
